nodes.name: .env.development
nodes.summary: Development environment configuration defining local backend service endpoints (expense, invoice, reservation, profit, tax, order, room, supplier, user, immigration registration, etc.), file-storage (MinIO) credentials, and dev server settings for the PMS app, with a block of legacy staging URLs kept as comments.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines ~30 REACT_APP_* endpoint variables consumed via process.env across the React app's service layer; commented-out lines preserve an alternate staging configuration.

nodes.name: PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Internal improvement-tracking document for the PMS project, listing completed bug fixes and refactors for order management, tour management save persistence, and dynamic room-name fetching in the reservation and invoice maps.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview for the PMS web app describing its expense tracking, invoicing, reservation status, and profit reporting features, plus setup instructions for the required .env service-endpoint variables and how to run the dev server.

nodes.name: Subscribe.txt
nodes.summary: Plain-text file containing a single YouTube channel URL; unrelated to application functionality.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: NPM manifest for the my-webpack-project PMS app, declaring React 18 + TypeScript dependencies (Firebase, Axios, Flowbite, react-router-dom, MinIO client, OIDC client, html2canvas) alongside Node.js browser polyfills, and defining react-app-rewired start/build/test/eject scripts.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses react-app-rewired to override Create React App's webpack config, and devDependency aliases to polyfill Node core modules (buffer, crypto, stream, https, zlib) for browser bundling.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the React app, targeting ES2016 with classic React JSX transform, CommonJS modules, strict type-checking, esModuleInterop, and forced consistent file-name casing.
nodes.languageNotes: Mostly the default CRA-generated template with commented-out optional flags; only a handful of options (target, jsx, module, esModuleInterop, strict, skipLibCheck) are actually enabled.
